items.title: 정당 지지율, 민주 36% vs 국힘 27%
items.snippet: 더불어민주당과 국민의힘의 정당 지지도가 2주 연속으로 한 자릿수 격차를 유지했다는 여론조사 결과가 16일 나왔다. 6·3 지방선거 이전 2배 이상으로 벌어지기도 했던 양당 지지율 격차가 좁혀지는 추세인 것. 내후년 총선에 대한 견해를 묻는 항목에선 “야당이 승리해야 한다”는 답변이 “여당 승리”를 기대하는 답변보다 우세한 것으로 나타났다. 한국갤럽이 13∼15일 전국 유권자 1003명을 대상으로 조사해 16일 발표한 여론조사(전화면접 방식, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 민주당과 국민의힘 지지율은 36%, 27%를 기록했다. 직전 주 조사에서 각각 35%, 26%였던 만큼 2주 연속으로 9%포인트 격차가 유지됐다. 6·3 지방선거 전이었던 4월 첫 주 조사에서 30...

items.title: “땅값 반토막났는데 농지조사까지… 거래도 대출도 막혀”
items.snippet: 박영규(72)씨는 경기 여주시에서 태어나 평생 농사만 지었다. 부모에게 물려받은 땅에 농사를 지으며 조금씩 사들인 땅까지, 그가 가진 농지는 총 1만3000평이다. 박씨에게는 노후 생활비로 쓰려고 평생 모은 ‘퇴직금’이 이 땅이다. 농사를 그만두려고 마음먹은 지 한참이 됐지만, 몇 년째 땅을 못 팔고 있다. 박씨는 “평당 20만원 하던 땅인데 지금은 10만원에 내놔도 쳐다보는 사람도 없다”며 “땅값이 떨어지니까 농지를 담보로 돈을 빌리기도 어려워졌다”고 했다.

items.title: “이대론 재판 못해” “공소사실에 흠결” 재판부 질책 받은 2차 특검
items.snippet: “이 상태로는 재판을 진행할 수 없습니다.” 지난 15일 서울중앙지법 508호. ‘순직 해병’ 사건 수사를 방해한 혐의로 기소된 이시원 전 대통령실 공직기강비서관 등의 직권남용 등 사건 재판에서 형사32부 류경진 재판장이 2차 종합특검을 질책했다. 특검팀이 제출한 증거목록에 어떤 공소사실을 입증하기 위한 증거들인지 구분돼 있지 않았기 때문이다. 3대 특검(내란·김건희·해병)이 다 못한 수사를 이어받아 수사하면서, 무리한 수사, 무더기 기소 등 논란이 끊이지 않았던 2차 특검이 법정에서도 물의를 일으키고 있다. 공소장을 잘못 쓰거나, 수사기록을 피고인 측에 제때 제공하지 않아 재판 진행에 차질을 빚고 있는 것이다. 법조계에선 “수사도 무리하게 하더니 기소도 졸속으로 했다는 게 재판에서 다 드러나고 있다”는 말이 나왔다.

items.title: 北인공기 그려진 미사일 모형 설치… 노원구 미술축제 논란
items.snippet: 서울 노원구가 16일 개막한 공공 미술 축제에 북한 인공기가 그려진 미사일 조형물이 설치됐다. 시민들 사이에선 “시민이 오가는 공공 장소에 북한 인공기가 그려진 작품을 설치하는 게 말이 되느냐”는 비판이 나왔다. 이에 대해 노원구는 “해당 작품이 당초 계획안과 다르게 설치됐다”고 해명했다.

items.title: 반도체 배우러, 폴리텍대 다시 가는 직장인들
items.snippet: 4년제 대학에서 영상애니메이션디자인을 전공한 김희건(27)씨는 졸업 후 게임 업계 취업을 준비하다 올해 한국폴리텍대 대구캠퍼스 그린반도체시스템과에 다시 입학했다. 최근 생성형 인공지능(AI)이 급속도로 발전하면서 디자인 분야 채용이 줄어드는 것을 보고 진로를 바꾼 것이다. AI 산업이 커질수록 반도체도 유망할 것이라는 생각이 들었다고 한다. 김씨는 “SK하이닉스에서 ‘억 소리’ 나는 성과급이 나온다는 이야기도 진로 선택에 영향을 미쳤다”고 했다.

items.title: 미인가 국제학교들 “대안교육기관 받아달라”

items.title: “안내견과 찾은 나의 길… 이젠 다른 이들의 길을 엽니다”
items.snippet: 삼성화재안내견학교 유석종 프로 (아무튼주말 게재 전 사용금지)- 영상미디어 이신영 기자" height="3210" src="https://www.chosun.com/resizer/v2/QNMJHPWJJNGS3A5X6MKGDXTPL4.jpg?auth=7953a36e732eacc19cb5c0fea2126f5becb47f293ff97ad2510258bc5f891b98&smart=true&width=4815&height=3210" width="4815" /> 앞을 볼 수 없는 이들의 자립을 도우며 스스로 길을 찾았다. 유석종(45) 삼성화재 안내견학교 프로는 올해로 20년째 시각장애인과 안내견을 연결하고 있는 ‘매칭 상담 전문가’다. 신청자의 보행 능력과 생활 방식, 재활 의지 등을 고려해 안내견과의 동행이 가능한지 판단하는 게 그의 일이다. 그렇게...

items.title: 떡 먹으려고 KTX 탄다… 2030 ‘떡지순례’ 열풍
items.snippet: 13일 오전 9시 30분 롯데백화점 잠실점 지하 식품관 입구. 문이 열리려면 한 시간이나 남았지만 이미 72명이 대기 중이었다. 이들은 지난 9일부터 15일까지 열린 ‘전국 떡지순례’ 팝업 행사의 입장 번호표를 받기 위해 새벽부터 집을 나섰다. 줄 맨 앞에 선 남성은 “오전 7시 15분에 도착했다”고 했다. 오전 10시 30분이 되자 대기 인원은 200명을 넘었다. 백화점 관계자는 “일부 인기 떡집은 오후 1시 준비한 떡이 다 팔려 조기 마감할 정도”라며 “떡의 인기를 실감하고 있다”고 했다.

items.title: 경복궁 영추문 앞 그 나무, 위험하다며 자른다는데…
items.snippet: “오래도록 살고 싶어요.” “우리를 자르지 말아요.”

items.title: 우리의 밤은 당신의 낮보다 아름답다
items.snippet: 파리 몽마르트르의 밤을 누군가의 이름으로 기억한다면 단연 앙리 드 툴루즈 로트레크(1864~1901)일 것이다. 화려한 무대, 객석의 웃음소리, 술잔 위로 내려앉은 짙은 피로까지 그가 캔버스에 담아낸 장면들은 지금도 당대의 환희를 생생히 되살린다. 전설적인 카바레 ‘물랭 루주’가 오늘날에도 그의 이름을 딴 툴루즈 로트레크 메뉴를 선보이며 경의를 표하는 까닭이며 세상이 그에게 ‘몽마르트르의 혼’이라는 찬사를 바치는 이유다. 부유한 귀족 출신 화가는 어쩌다 무희와 가수, 거리의 여성들이 살아가는 밤의 환락가를 그리게 됐을까? 그 배경에 샹송 가수 아리스티드 브뤼앙(1851~1925)이 있었다.

items.title: 짧고 굵게, 아파트 명칭도 재건축 바람
items.snippet: 이름에는 당대의 미감이 담긴다. 이를테면 1970년대 지어진 서울 서초 신동아1·2차아파트는 반세기 전 작명 규칙에 충실한 이름이었다. 지난해 재건축 공사에 돌입해 곧 고급 주거 단지로 천지개벽할 이 아파트, 새 이름이 관건이었다. 2017년 건설사가 제시한 건 ‘아크로 클라우드 파크’였다. 구름 위 천상 공원. 건설사 브랜드 뒤에 거창한 펫네임(petname·별칭)을 붙이는, 10년 전 유행에 부합하는 이름. 그랬던 이름은 2022년 ‘아크로 드 서초’로 확 줄었고, 지난 4월 한 글자가 더 줄어 ‘아크로 서초’로 최종 확정됐다.

items.title: 어제보다 먼 곳으로
items.snippet: 자동차 업계가 자율주행 기술 주도권을 놓고 치열한 경쟁을 벌이고 있습니다. 운전자가 핸들이나 페달을 조작하지 않아도 자동차가 스스로 목적지까지 찾아가게 하는 기술 말이죠. 그런데 이 기술이 정말 절실한 곳은 지구가 아니라 화성인지도 모르겠습니다.

items.title: 그 시절, 좋은 지도자들
items.snippet: 1985년 3월에 54세의 미하일 고르바초프가 소련 최고 지도자로 선출됐습니다. 그는 ‘새로운 사고(思考)’를 내세우며 ‘페레스트로이카’와 ‘글라스노스트’, 즉 ‘개혁’과 ‘개방’을 주창했습니다. 이른바 ‘민주주의적 공산주의’를 주장한 것입니다. 그것은 폴란드 철학자 레셰크 코와코프스키가 사용한 표현에 따르면 ‘구워진 눈덩이’와 같은 것이었습니다. 과연 고르바초프가 눈덩이를 구울 수 있을까? 큰 의문이었습니다. 그는 비정통적인 방식의 협상 제안과 매력적인 공격으로 서방 측을 부드럽게 압박했습니다. 많은 서방 측 지도자들이 당황했습니다. 독일 헬무트 콜 총리는 고르바초프를 일단 선전술의 귀재로 보았습니다. 미심쩍어하면서도 큰 틀의 역사적 화해를 생각했습니다. 콜 총리는 한 인터뷰에서 나치의 괴벨스도 선전술의 대가였다고 언급했습니다. 물론 비보도...

items.title: 미야자키 하야오도 반한 이끼의 섬
items.snippet: 오제를 걷다 보면 때때로 깊은 산을 통과해야 할 때가 있다. 길은 가파른데 유혹하는 것들이 많다. 삼나무와 이끼다. 그러나 오제의 이끼를 ‘최고’라 말하진 않겠다. 이끼라면 역시 야쿠시마(屋久島) 아닌가. 오제보다 석 달 먼저 방문한 ‘야쿠시마’를 소환하는 이유다. 가고시마현 남단의 섬, 야쿠시마는 제주도의 4분의 1 정도 면적으로 원시림을 비롯한 산악 지역이 1993년 유네스코 세계자연유산에 등재됐다.

items.title: 위스키, 위기일까 기회일까
items.snippet: 스카치위스키가 위기라고 한다. 스코틀랜드 창고에서 숙성 중인 오크통은 약 2200만 통, 50억L가 넘는다. 영국 파이낸셜타임스(FT)는 이 가운데 팔릴 양보다 더 만들어 쌓아 둔 잉여 원액만 14억L에 달한다고 보도했다. 10년 전 4억L에도 못 미치던 양이 3.5배 이상으로 불어난 것이다. 2008년 리먼 브러더스 사태 이후 저금리로 갈 곳 잃은 돈이 위스키 같은 실물자산으로 몰렸다. 결정적 계기는 코로나19였다. ‘홈술’ 열풍 속에 오래 두고 마실 수 있는 위스키가 주목받았다. 업계가 더 많이 만들어 쌓아 둔 건 당연한 선택이었다.

items.title: 상대 아픈 곳 찌르고 조롱하는 말
items.snippet: 가려운 데가 있으면 손톱으로 시원하게 긁어야 하고, 기분 좋은 일이 있으면 화끈하게 카드를 긁어야 한다. 사전에 올라 있는 ‘긁다’의 첫 번째 뜻과 마지막 뜻은 이러하다. 갈퀴로 나뭇잎을 긁고 주걱으로 누룽지를 긁는 것은 순한 뜻이다. 그러나 남을 헐뜯거나 재산을 빼앗는 것, 남의 기분을 상하게 하거나 공연히 일을 키우는 것, 기관총을 마구 쏘아대는 것은 그리 좋은 뜻은 아니다. 그런데 요즘의 쓰임을 보면 ‘긁?’도 사전에 올려야 하는 것은 아닌가 하는 의문이 든다.

items.title: 수집가의 안목이 느껴지는 청화백자 접시
items.snippet: ‘국중박(국립중앙박물관) 분장놀이’에 대한 반응이 이렇게 뜨거울 줄 몰랐다. 발랄하고 개성 넘치는 올해의 대상 수상자와 더불어 청화백자 잉어 모양 연적의 인기도 절정에 올랐기에, 이 기회를 빌려 청화백자 한 점을 소개해보려 한다.

items.title: 우리는 AI를 웃길 수 있을까
items.snippet: 우리는 매일 수많은 사회 현상을 마주합니다. 빠르게 번지는 유행, 집단적 쏠림 현상, 그리고 이해하기 어려운 선택의 반복…. 사람들은 왜 그렇게 생각하고 행동하는 걸까요? 인지심리학자인 김경일 아주대 심리학과 교수가 겉으로 드러난 현상 이면에 작동하는 기제가 개인의 선택과 집단의 움직임에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 짚어봅니다. – 편집자 주

items.title: “녹음합니다, 저를 지킬 최후의 보루니까요”
items.snippet: 정구승 법무법인 일로 대표 변호사는 최근 사건 의뢰를 받으면 가장 먼저 던지는 질문이 있다. 바로 사건의 ‘녹음 증거’를 가지고 있느냐는 것. 정 변호사는 “가정폭력이나 사기, 성범죄처럼 외부에 잘 드러나지 않는 범행에 휘말린 경우에는 자신에게 유리한 녹취록을 수사기관에 제출하는 게 필수”라며 “안 그래도 사건이 몰려 처리가 느린 경찰이 보완수사까지 떠맡게 되면서 피의자와 피해자 모두 공정하고 빠른 종결을 위해 사건 실체를 담은 녹음 증거 수집이 더 중요해졌다”고 말했다.

items.title: 화산이 만든 천상의 습지… 100㎏ 짐 메고 목도를 걷는 ‘짐꾼 수행자’를 만나다
items.snippet: 2016년 여름 늦은 밤, 귀가를 신고하듯 습관처럼 TV를 켰다. 광활한 초록 속 끝없는 목도, 자기 키만 한 짐을 진 짐꾼이 그 길을 걷고 있었다. 구도자처럼 보였다. 박혁지 감독의 다큐멘터리 ‘길 위의 인생-인생을 짊어지고, 일본 봇카(歩荷)’였다. ‘오제(尾瀬)’는 ‘천상의 화원’이라 불린다는데, 예쁜 발음이라 마음에 쏙 새겨졌다.

items.title: 알고 보면 역사가 길지 않은 각국 대표 음식들
items.snippet: 다양한 외국 음식이 우리 식단을 더 풍성하게 만들고 있다. 그런데 오랜 세월 이어져 왔을 것 같은 각국 대표 음식 중에 의외로 역사가 길지 않은 경우가 많다. 미국을 상징하는 햄버거는 19세기 말 독일 이주민들이 함부르크 스타일로 구운 스테이크를 넣어 팔던 네모난 샌드위치에서 유래했다. 오늘날의 형태를 갖춘 건 1916년 동그란 모양의 햄버거용 번이 나오면서부터였고 1950년대 맥도날드·버거킹 같은 대형 프랜차이즈가 성장하면서 미 전역으로 확산됐다.

items.title: 부드럽게 풀려 산뜻하게 녹아드는 맛
items.snippet: 어머니와 스시를 먹으면 꼭 아버지 이야기를 하게 된다. “너희 아빠가 그렇게 스시를 좋아했는데 나중엔 먹지도 못하고.” 아버지는 간암 진단을 받고 얼마 후에 의사에게서 ‘날것을 삼가는 게 좋겠다’는 말을 들었다. 그 이후 아버지는 날것을 먹지 않았다. 어머니도 덩달아 스시 먹을 일이 사라졌다. 평생 먹는 것을 참는 게 힘들던 아버지는 생애 마지막에는 그 어떤 음식을 가져가도 고개를 저었다. 아버지께 ‘드시라’고 애원하는 날이 찾아오리라고는 생각하지 못했다. 아버지와 달리 어머니는 먹는 데 취미가 없었다. 건강 진단을 받으면 백이면 백 “식사를 잘해야 한다”는 말을 듣는 것도 오래됐다. 회사 쉬는 날 어머니와 따로 약속을 잡는 데는, 한 끼라도 제대로 채워주고 싶은 노림수도 있었다.

items.title: “당신은 우리 편인가, 남의 편인가”… 연예인 정치색 따지는 사회
items.snippet: #1. “혹시 박진영 위원장은 저쪽에 섰나.” 7일 국회 문화체육관광위원회 국정감사에서 조은희 국민의힘 의원이 박진영 대중문화교류위원회 공동위원장에게 이렇게 말하자, 박 위원장은 두 손으로 얼굴을 감싸며 실소를 보였다. 조 의원은 박 위원장이 이재명 대통령과 함께 찍은 사진을 언급하며 “(박 위원장의) 명성이 이 정권의 흥망과 같이 가는 것 아닌가, 걱정을 하게 됐다”고 말했다. 이에 박 위원장은 “이 정권이나 민주당을 위해 일한다는 생각은 1초도 해본 적이 없다”고 해명했다.

items.title: 한국에서는 왜 노벨 과학상 수상자가 안 나올까
items.snippet: “우리나라에선 언제쯤 노벨상이 나올까?” 이런 말을 하는 분들이 꽤 많다. 이웃 일본이 거의 매년 노벨상을 받으며 ‘엄친아’ 역할을 하고 있으니, 박탈감이 더 클 수밖에 없다. 물론 우리나라에서도 노벨상이 두 번 나왔다. 2000년 김대중 전 대통령이 평화상을, 2024년에는 한강 작가가 문학상을 탔다. 두 분의 수상은 높이 평가받아야 하지만, 그런데도 우리가 계속 노벨상 타령을 하는 것은 과학 분야 수상자가 나오지 않아서다. 과학 분야 노벨상(이하 과학상)이야말로 국력의 정도를 보여주는 지표이기 때문이다.

items.title: Indonesia's forest fires spark public health crisis across Southeast Asia
items.snippet: Massive wildfires in Indonesia show no sign of letting up. The environmental disaster is turning into a pollution crisis across Southeast Asia, as toxic haze from the blazes spread to neighbouring countries.

items.title: Elon Musk Is Almost Single-Handedly Funding the Republican Midterms Push

items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 오늘(16일) "부마 민주항쟁과 광주 민주화 운동을 헌법 전문에 담아내는 일은 대한민국의 민주주의와 국민주권을 지켜내기 위한, 우리 국민의 피어린 역사를 잊지 않도록 하는 최소한의 조치"라며 "개헌을 위한 국민 의견 수렴과 합리적 토론에 국회가 조속히 나서달라"고 요청했습니다.이 대통령은 이날 부산시청에서 열린 제47주년 부마 민주항쟁 기념식에 참석해 이같이 밝혔습니다.이 대통령은 "47년 전 오늘, 부산과 마산에서 시작된 함성은 거대한 독재의 어둠을 뚫고 꺼지지 않는 불꽃이 돼 민주공화국 대한민국을 환하게 밝혔다"며 "엄혹했던 시대에 정의를 온몸으로 외친 부산과 마산의 시민 여러분께 깊은 존경과 감사의..

items.snippet: 2028년 제23대 총선을 약 1년 6개월 앞두고 여당 후보보다 야당 후보의 다수 당선을 바라는 여론이 우세하다는 여론조사 결과가 오늘(16일) 나왔습니다.한국갤럽이 지난 13∼15일 전국 만 18세 이상 1,003명을 대상으로 내년 총선 결과 전망을 조사한 결과, '현 정부를 견제하기 위해 야당 후보가 많이 당선돼야 한다'(정부 견제론)는 응답은 47%로 집계됐습니다.'현 정부를 지원하기 위해 여당 후보가 많이 당선돼야 한다'(정부 지원론)은 34%로 나타났습니다.지역별로는 서울에서 '정부 견제론'이 55%로 가장 높게 나타났고, '정부 지원론'은 전남광주·전북에서 60%로 가장 높았습니다.연령대별로는 40대(50%)..

items.title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange meta...

items.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
items.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem size...

items.snippet: 지난 13일 전북 전주에서 별거 중인 아내를 흉기로 살해한 70대는 스토킹과 가정폭력으로 접근·연락금지 명령이 내려진 상태였고, 숨진 아내는 앞서 8차례나 경찰에 신고해 도움을 요청했던 것으로 15일 드러났다. 이처럼 경찰이 위험 신호를 파악하고도 참극을 막지 못한 흉악범죄가 잇따르고 있다. 최근 1주일 사이 5건이나 발생했다. 12일 제주에서는 지난해부터 스토킹과 성폭력 등을 4차례 신고한 40대 여성이 과거 연인이었던 60대 남성에게 살해됐다. 피해 여성은 당시 경찰에 구조요청을 할 수 있는 스마트워치를 차고 있었지만 가해자가 뜯어내 사용하지 못했다. 같은 날 서귀포에서는 이혼 소송 중인 아내와 양육권 분쟁을 벌이던 40대 남성이 4세 딸과 함께 숨진 채 발견됐다. 아내는 열흘 전 “딸이 위험하다”고 알렸지만, 경찰은 112로 정식 접수된...

items.title: 시간별 투표자 수 허위 입력… 지역 선관위 25곳 추가 확인
items.snippet: 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하는 선거관리위원회 특별검사팀(특별검사 이태한)은 전국 30개 시군구 선관위에서 6·3 지방선거 당시 시간대별 투표자수를 허위로 입력한 사실을 확인했다고 15일 밝혔다. 종전 검경 합동수사본부가 확인한 5곳에 더해 전국 25곳에서 같은 문제가 드러났다는 것이다. 특검팀은 이날 지역 선관위가 특정 업체에 선거물품 보관계약 특혜를 준 정황도 포착해 압수수색에 나섰다.

items.title: 검찰미래위 조사단 “위례 비리 수사, 위법성 없었다” 결론
items.snippet: 과거 검찰의 수사권 남용 의혹을 조사 중인 검찰인권존중미래위원회(검찰미래위) 진상조사단이 15일 이재명 대통령이 기소된 위례 신도시 개발 비리와 서해 공무원 피격, 문재인 정부 부동산 통계 조작 등 3건에 대한 검찰 수사에는 문제가 없었다고 결론 내렸다. 하지만 검찰미래위는 조사단에 추가 조사를 요구한 것으로 확인됐다. 법조계에서는 “검찰미래위가 추가 조사를 해서라도 검찰 수사의 문제점을 찾으려는 것 같다”는 반응이 나왔다.

items.snippet: 지난해 특목고·자사고·영재학교의 1학년 학업 중단자(자퇴·퇴학 등)가 최근 5년 새 최저 수준으로 떨어졌다. 내신 5등급제 도입으로 성적 부담이 줄어든 데다, 학교별 특화 교육과정이 대입에서 강점이 될 것이라는 기대도 작용한 것으로 분석된다.

items.title: 7년간 치료 이겨내고… 바다로 돌아가는 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’
items.snippet: 15일 오전 제주 서귀포시 광치기해변에서 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’가 바다로 방류되고 있다. 럭키는 2019년 8월 제주 해변에서 그물과 낚시 도구에 걸려 상처를 입은 채 발견돼 해양 동물 전문 구조 기관인 아쿠아플라넷 제주에서 7년간 치료받은 끝에 이날 방류됐다.

items.title: “노후화 된 공업 지역… AI·로봇 산업 거점으로”
items.snippet: 서울 영등포구에는 여의도 금융가와 문래동 철공소 거리, 아파트 단지 등이 섞여 있다. 최근엔 데이터센터 건립을 둘러싼 갈등도 벌어지고 있다. 조유진(66) 영등포구청장은 지난 13일 본지 인터뷰에서 “영등포 곳곳의 낡은 공업 지역을 AI(인공지능), 로봇 산업 거점으로 바꾸겠다”고 말했다. 조 구청장은 국회의원 보좌관, 대통령비서실 행정관 출신으로 지난 6·3 영등포구청장 선거에 더불어민주당 후보로 출마해 당선됐다.

items.snippet: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.

items.title: “내가 벌써 백살이라니? 하하하”… 여전히 패기 넘쳤다
items.snippet: 15일 서울 고덕동에 대낮부터 ‘별’들이 쏟아졌다. 이정재, 이영애, 이재, 박찬욱, 김무열 등 한류 스타를 비롯해 임권택, 박근형, 박정자, 손숙, 고은아, 정혜선, 백일섭, 유인촌, 유동근, 전인화, 박상원, 최명길, 인순이, 배창호, 김수철, 박찬호, 정준호 등 문화예술계 명사 100여 명이 운집했다. 영화계 ‘큰별’이자 어른인 신영균 선생의 백수(白壽)를 축하하기 위해서다.

items.title: [플라자] 서울총장포럼·관훈클럽 업무협약 체결
items.snippet: 서울총장포럼과 관훈클럽은 15일 대학 교육과 현장 저널리즘의 연계를 강화하기 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 이에 따라 내년부터 관훈클럽 회원들이 서울총장포럼 소속 39개 대학에서 자신의 전문 분야와 취재 경험을 살려 정규 강의나 특강을 할 수 있는 시스템이 마련된다.

items.title: 방미통위, KBS 이사 2명 임명 제청… 방문진·EBS 이사도 각 2명 임명
items.snippet: 방송미디어통신위원회(방미통위)는 15일 제42차 전체 회의에서 이강덕 관훈클럽정신영기금 이사장과 장한식 전 KBS비즈니스 사장을 한국방송공사(KBS) 이사로 대통령에게 임명 제청하기로 했다. 또 오정환 전 공정언론국민연대 공동대표와 정재욱 법무법인 태원 변호사를 방송문화진흥회(방문진) 이사로, 박기완 전 KBS 원주방송국장과 조한제 전 벡스코 상임감사를 EBS 이사로 임명하기로 했다. 6명 모두 국민의힘 추천 인사다. 방미통위는 아울러 EBS 이사회가 임명 제청한 김장환 전 KBS 대구방송총국장을 EBS 감사로 임명하기로 의결했다. 방문진·EBS 이사와 EBS 감사의 임명일은 오는 19일이다.

items.title: [알립니다] 우리 아이 출생 소식 액자에 담아 간직하세요
items.snippet: 조선일보에 실린 아기 출생 소식, 본인이나 지인의 인터뷰·사진 기사를 영원히 추억으로 간직하세요. 조선일보는 독자가 원하는 신문 지면을 그대로 고급 액자에 담아 드리는 ‘조선일보 리프린트’ 서비스를 합니다. 매주 ‘아이가 행복입니다’ 지면에 소개된 한 가족을 추첨해 리프린트를 선물로 드립니다. 지난 2일 ‘우리 아기가 태어났어요’ 코너에 실린 김태리 양이 이번 주 주인공입니다. 자세한 내용은 홈페이지(reprint.chosun.com)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

items.title: 직원 지방 이사에… 재택근무 허용하고 현지 사무실 마련했죠
items.snippet: 한 살 아이를 키우는 김승희 화정엔지니어링 경영기획부 과장은 지난 4월 1년간의 육아휴직을 마치고 복직했다. 복직과 동시에 육아기 근로시간 단축을 신청했지만, 아이가 자주 아파 출근하기 어려운 날도 있었다. 그럴 때마다 회사는 재택근무를 허용했다. 김 과장은 “단축 근무 중에도 아이가 아프면 흔쾌히 재택근무를 허용해줘 육아와 일을 병행하는 데 큰 도움이 됐다”고 했다. 휴직 전 맡았던 업무도 그대로 이어가고 있다.

items.title: [우리 아기가 태어났어요] 이은빈·홍지명 아들 이준 외
items.snippet: 온 가족에게 기쁨을 안겨 준 아기의 탄생을 알려주세요. 홈페이지 주소 입력창에 아가야안녕.com이라고 입력하면 됩니다. 매일유업 육아 정보 사이트 매일아이(maeili.com)를 통해서도 접속할 수 있습니다. 추첨을 통해 출산 소식과 사진이 지면에 실린 가족에게는 ①케이크 구매권 ②엄마와 아이를 위한 매일두 포인트 3만원 ③출산 소식을 생일 날짜 본지 1면에 담은 PDF 파일 ④조선일보 1개월 무료 구독권을 드립니다. 당첨자 중 한 가족을 선정하여 해당 지면을 고급 프레임에 담아 제공하는 조선일보 리프린트도 제작해 드립니다. 홈페이지에서는 균형 영양식 메디웰 2만원 할인 혜택도 드리고 있습니다.

items.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
items.abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates $-$ they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of $7\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Eu$^{2+}$ ion stems from a half-filled $4f$ shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. Here we characterize an epitaxial film of the metamagnet EuSe on diamagnetic BaF$_2$ by magnetometry and broadband ferromagnetic resonance from 10 K down to 30 mK. items.abstract: A novel silicon allotrope, qtz Si, with quartz topology is proposed and investigated alongside four known allotropes (dia Si-I, lon Si-IV, bsn Si-II, and gsi Si-III) using first-principles density functional theory. qtz Si is found to exhibit the smallest atom-averaged volume (18.06 A3), highest density (2.582 g/cm3), highest bulk modulus (98 GPa), and highest maximum phonon frequency (16 THz) among the five, while showing the lowest shear modulus (37 GPa). All five allotropes are confirmed to satisfy the Born stability criteria and to display positive phonon frequencies throughout the Brillouin zone, i.e., they are mechanically and dynamically stable. Electronic structure calculations show that qtz Si is a semimetal with a vanishing gap, whereas dia Si and lon Si are semiconductors, and bsn and gsi allotropes are weakly metallic. items.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
items.abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. items.title: Robust Data-Driven Controller Synthesis from Sampled and Uncertain Frequency Response Estimates using Integral Quadratic Constraints
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. The approach is based on an iterative design procedure using \emph{integral quadratic constraints} (IQCs). It generalizes existing data-driven methods that approximate semi-infinite IQC conditions by enforcing them on a finite set of measured frequency points. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. The effectiveness and computational efficiency of the approach...

items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. Transistor-level SKY130 simulations show that the second run gives the gradient within 1.9%; that hardware linearisation permits large, noise-robust error signals; that a 13-cell network learns the Iris data s...

items.title: On-sky performance and prospects of near-infrared CMOS detectors in exoplanet detection: first year of SPIRIT
items.abstract: Ultracool dwarfs are promising targets for detecting and characterising temperate terrestrial exoplanets. Their flux peaks in the near-infrared, beyond the wavelength cut-off of the silicon-based CCDs used by ground-based surveys dedicated to observing them, such as SPECULOOS. We present the on-sky performance of SPIRIT (SPeculoos InfraRed Imager for Transits), an InGaAs CMOS detector on the Callisto telescope at the SPECULOOS Southern Observatory, during its first year of operation, from mid-2022 to 2023. We use 328 visits of 73 targets to optimise our CMOS-specific reduction process, including our approach to glow effects and bad-pixel handling. We find the measured precision to be consistent with our theoretical noise model, achieving sub-part-per-thousand precision under good observing conditions across targets spanning $J$-band magnitudes of 10--13. items.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET)-based compute-in-memory (CIM) promises energy-efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference, but device variation can severely degrade bit-sliced CIM accuracy. Prior works either rely on hardware modifications or treat such variation as generic noise, overlooking a key FeFET asymmetry: negligible off-state leakage makes errors dominated by conducting on-state cells. This asymmetry is amplified by two's-complement sign extension, which maps small negative values to high-significance bit slices and magnifies their errors during shift-and-add reconstruction. In this paper, we propose CAFE, a conducting-cell-aware adaptive differential encoding framework built upon this FeFET-specific asymmetry. items.title: Pressure engineering of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape and exciton-charge interplay in semiconductor moiré superlattices
items.abstract: Semiconductor moiré superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moiré potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. items.abstract: We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. items.title: Programmable Polaron Models and Tomography in Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulators
items.abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. Here, we propose a trapped-ion blueprint for realizing spin-phonon Hamiltonians with programmable spatial coupling between excitation density and phonon displacements, encompassing local Holstein and long-range Fröhlich-type interactions. items.title: Single anyons and anyon binding in a quantum Hall dot
items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. However, experiments to date have focused on probing anyons in structures in which many anyonic excitations coexist and interact. Here, we demonstrate the trapping of a single anyon in a device consisting of a graphene-based quantum point contact with an embedded tunable quantum Hall dot. Benchmarking our device at v = 1, we demonstrate backscattering between Fermi liquid edge states mediated by the whole-electron Coulomb blockade of the dot. The cleanliness and control available in our device allow depletion of the dot to the last quasihole, and we observe spin blockade for transitions to the opposite-spin Landau level. items.abstract: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. The presence of ordered O vacancies is energetically favoured on these surfaces and tends to reduce the corresponding work functions. These findings underscore the...

items.title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. items.abstract: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, Γ-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. items.title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
items.abstract: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. items.title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. items.abstract: We propose a novel amorphous oxide semiconductor (AOS)-based conductive-semiconducting-conductive (CSC) MOS test structure to effectively sense, discriminate, and analyze distinct trap-induced conductance losses in AOS transistors. In conventional test structures, non-ideal metal-AOS contacts convolute the conductance loss generated by various trap states. The CSC architecture mitigates these contact-related artifacts, enabling the decoupling of interface states and shallow states. Furthermore, the contributions from leakage, series resistance, and device-geometry effects are identified and calibrated. items.title: Toward Partitioned Reference Readout for Four-Level IGZO Memory: Device Statistics, Confusion Matrices, and INT4 Error Propagation
items.abstract: Four-level indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) 2T0C memory needs reliable state formation, sensing references, and a path from cell errors to digital weights. We analyze 107 measured DC transfer curves from 37 isolated IGZO transistors (W/L = 3/0.5 micrometers). Four gate-bias operating points inferred from the first sweep are evaluated on later sweeps of 35 devices. Device-resolved operating points reduce second-sweep across-device current standard deviation by 49.4-52.4%, yet retaining initial thresholds increases misclassified points from 37/140 to 55/140. Leave-one-device-out reference estimation gives 0/140 on the second sweep; freezing second-sweep thresholds yields 6/140 on the third. Sampling eight reference transistors on the third sweep gives a mean held-out error fraction of 0.15% over 2,000 selections, versus 4.33% with frozen thresholds on matched held-out devices. items.title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. items.title: The Era of Vibe Tapeout: Dark Age or Golden Age for Analog Circuit Design?
items.abstract: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. items.title: Localized Joule heating and carbonization process optimization of 3D printed polymer structures for lab-on-CMOS applications
items.abstract: Use of carbon electrodes integrated with CMOS technology has great promise for lab-on-chip, biomedical, environmental, and industrial applications. One method of developing carbon electrodes is to 3D print polymer nanostructures on a CMOS chip, and use a thermal annealing process to pyrolyze them into carbon at high temperature, approximately 950 °C. Such high temperature is detrimental to the CMOS sensor circuits, causing severe degradation. We present a novel solution of localized Joule heating of these polymer nanostructures to achieve complete carbonization of the electrodes. Both analytical and COMSOL simulations guided the experiments to characterize the carbonization process conditions. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. Rather than committing to a single representation, TileCas allows an agent to transfer and refine candidates across levels through Cross-Level Diagnosis, which maps correctness and performance feedback to actionable controls at different abstraction level...

items.title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. First-principles calculations attribute this selective tunability...

items.title: AI Acceleration of Muon Collider R&D: A Report from the AI4MuC Workshop
items.abstract: A Muon Collider is one of the most attractive routes to multi-TeV lepton collisions, but it requires the accelerator and detector communities to solve a tightly coupled set of problems that have no close precedent in an operating collider. Muons must be produced, captured, cooled, accelerated, and collided before they decay. The detector must then extract clean physics from an environment dominated by decay products from the beamline. Artificial intelligence is not a substitute for accelerator physics, detector design, or engineering validation. It is, however, unusually well matched to several of the central obstacles: high-dimensional design spaces, expensive simulations, coupled subsystem trade-offs, and workflows that are currently too slow or too fragile to support broad design exploration. This report distills the AI4MuC workshop into a summary of AI use cases with the potential to...

items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. Unlike approaches based primarily on phenomenological leakage models, our first-principles, multi-terminal quantum-tran...

items.title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. Thes...

items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated sam...

items.title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. Based on these findings, we propose a SERS-active system that provides strong signal enhancement (up to four orders of magnitude for a single globular object) while maintaining spectral fidelity, where PMSs act both as model analytes and as integral components of a metal-dielectric...

items.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. items.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. In a separate high-field-calibrated benchmark, RK removes 66.8% of the orbital error of a pure two-dimensional Coulomb reference, making the remaining state-selective deviations particularly informative. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential...

items.title: From Prompts to Silicon: Scaling LLM-Assisted Chip Design with the AI Hardware Design League
items.abstract: The semiconductor workforce shortage has renewed interest in making chip design accessible to students without conventional very-large-scale integration (VLSI) training. We present the AI Hardware Design League (AI-HDL), an international, project-based competition in which students use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively refine Verilog while simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, security review, and physical verification provide the engineering feedback needed to validate the result. Across two annual cycles, AI-HDL grew from 172 to 604 participants and from 40 to 108 teams, reaching 30 universities, six community colleges, and 19 countries. In the 2026 cohort, 68.7% of participants reported no prior Verilog experience. Twenty-two teams completed the four design phases and reached final evaluation. Two division-winning designs completed physical sign-off in the Sky...

items.title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
items.abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. items.abstract: Students often perceive scientific experiments as clean, straightforward procedures with predictable outcomes. Students' beliefs about the nature of experimental physics typically remain inconsistent through the initial stages of undergraduate education. In reality, experimental work in physics involves hands-on activities such as soldering circuits, assembling provisional setups, and building functional mock-ups from simple materials before reliable measurements can be achieved. To address this gap, we designed a laboratory activity in which students were completely involved in the experiment design, construction and operation with the final goal of measuring the speed of light with a low-cost and compact setup. items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. items.title: Spatiotemporal computing for temporal nonlinear tasks using few-mode fiber and SOA nonlinearity
items.abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. In previous studies, we have demonstrated linear classification tasks with such FMFs, such as ultrafast multibit header recognition. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We experimentally evaluate the architecture at 28.5 Gb/s on two delayed XOR and higher-order parity tasks. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.title: ATLAS: Adaptive TDA-guided Landscape-Aware Transistor Sizing
items.abstract: Analog transistor sizing, finding design parameters that simultaneously satisfy multiple performance specifications, is a labor-intensive bottleneck in circuit design. To support analog circuit experts, various automation methods have been proposed, including Bayesian optimization (BO), reinforcement learning (RL), and others. Yet existing methods are oblivious to the topological structure of a feasible design space, which can fragment into disconnected regions due to operating-regime transitions, conflicting specification trade-offs, and nonconvex device physics. This topological blindness causes the optimizer to converge within a single feasible region while missing others that may contain superior designs. items.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.title: Quantum-vortex excitons beyond band topology
items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. Here, we explain how Coulomb phase matching stabilises a quantum-vortex exciton as the lowest bound state in flat Chern bands. Using a prototypical Yin--Yang kagome lattice, we demonstrate that increasing the spin--orbit coupling drives a transition of the lowest exciton from a quantum-vortex state to a zero-winding state, while leaving the band Chern numbers unchanged. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. By comparing states with identical wavefunction amplitudes, we isolate this phase contribution and show that it is sufficient to drive the reversal in exciton ordering. We classify exciton topology by the momentum-space wavefunction winding relativ...

items.title: Surface Physics of Low-Dimensional Pnictogen Chalcohalides and Its Impact on Photovoltaic Technologies
items.abstract: Low-dimensional pnictogen chalcohalides (MChX; M = Bi, Sb; Ch = S, Se; X = I, Br) are promising non-toxic semiconductors for solar energy conversion, yet the power conversion efficiencies of MChX solar cells remain below 10%, far from their Shockley-Queisser limit of $\sim$30%. Efficient charge extraction depends critically on the band-edge alignment between the absorber and the charge-selective contacts, which is a surface property. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with device-level modelling to investigate the surface energetics and band alignments across the MChX family. An exhaustive sampling of crystal orientations, including low-symmetry facets, identifies the (011) and (010) surfaces as the most stable terminations in all eight compounds. Their formation energies differ by only $\approx 0.01$-$0.03\mathrm{J\,m^{-2}}$, yet their band edges are shifted rigidly with res...

items.abstract: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. items.title: MarketRank: ranking stocks by the stationary probabilities of a Markov chain over estimated money flows, with a topological landscape view
items.abstract: Every trading day, money leaves some stocks and moves into others. MarketRank asks where that money concentrates and how the concentration shifts over time. It treats the market as a Markov chain whose states are stocks. The chance of moving from one stock to another is the share of the first stock's outgoing dollars that goes to the second, and a stock's MarketRank score is its long run (stationary) probability in that chain, computed by damped power iteration on a sparse transition matrix. PageRank ranks web pages with the same idea, using links instead of dollars. Who sold what to buy what is not public, so the flows are estimated from daily prices and volumes with a correlation tilted gravity model, in a deterministic parallel C++ engine. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. This paper asks what happens when cost is present from the start. We build CacheFit, the first policy-design loop for LLC replacement with circuit-level cost inside the search objective. CacheF...

items.abstract: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. items.title: Vacancy aggregation enhances NV- spin coherence in diamond: a cluster-correlation-expansion study of multi-vacancy spin baths in semiconductors
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. A bath dephases the qubit because its spins exchange spin projections with one another, and two can exchange only if their transition frequencies match. A fine-structure splitting shifts t...

Low-energy muon spin rotation further reveals that Ni contacts create a magnetically contaminated region extending at least $\sim$110 nm into the SiC, in stark contrast to non-magnetic contacts such as Ti and Al. items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions renormalize phonon frequencies and lifetimes and are central to the dynamical properties of solids. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. In both materials, the two interaction channels renormalize the phonon spectrum in qualitatively distinct ways. To address this challenge, this paper presents a Non-ideality Optimized eNVM Accelerator (NOVA) architecture for on-chip training. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of...

Here we investigate octanethiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7% to 4%, reducing the free electron density. items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
items.abstract: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. items.title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-Ray Detection With Commercial Off-The-Shelf CMOS Sensors
items.abstract: This work presents high-resolution X-ray microtomography based on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors. The system uses a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast imaging, thanks to the sensor s intrinsic resolution, and phase-contrast imaging, by adjusting the object-to-sensor distance. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced sensor degradation during long acquisitions. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 microns to 5.2 microns, with an effective spatial resolution (FWHM) as fine as 9.6 microns in magnified phase-contrast mode (1.33x) and 21 microns in non-magnified absorption-contrast mode. Phase contrast enhances visualization of soft tissue boundaries that are difficult to visualize using absorption-contrast imaging in the same experimental configuration.

items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. Transaction-based network energy models were developed in 2009 to understand the evolution o...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp1...

items.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing.
